family: SG4 segment with SA, label with CA (standalone)
independent_of: every other SG family; uses only the frozen CA seed, frozen SA module 15 and the released token

partitions.SPEC: k-means on the K leading, row-normalized eigenvectors of D^-1/2 S D^-1/2, S = (A_bar + A_bar^T)/2
partitions.ROWS: k-means on the L2-normalized rows of A_bar

kmeans: k-means++ from seed 0, 3 restarts, 30 iterations, lowest inertia

labels.cmean: mean CA seed in the region
labels.rmean: mean REF (mean_i A_i c) in the region

informed_by: no DenseCRF, no other SG; K spans coarse to fine because the visuals show region-scale errors (filled gaps, context such as chairs); region labels from the frozen seed, as registered, and from REF because one-pass SA is the frozen evidence
tie_order: within 0.002: cmean > cmed > rmean, then SPEC > ROWS, then K 8 > 16 > 32 (fewer regions first)
diagnostics: per image: oracle-region IoU for every partition (region = object when >= half its 64x64 pixels are object), non-empty region count, new TP / new FP against the seed and REF at 0.45
transfer: COCO-Cap: every cell at its all-VOC threshold; frozen cells against their references (paired bootstrap); never selects
